generation.explanation: The general sine wave y = A sin(B(x − C)) + D is shaped by four parameters: A (amplitude) stretches it vertically, B (frequency) controls how fast it oscillates, C (phase shift) slides it left/right, and D (vertical shift) moves it up/down. Drag the sliders to reshape the wave in real time and see how each constant transforms the graph.
